faq.title: Good to know before you book

conditions.a: The driver must be at least 21 years old and have held a valid driving licence for at least 2 years.

documents.a: A valid ID (national ID card or passport), your driving licence and a means of payment.

insurance.a: Yes, our cars are covered under the terms of the rental contract. Additional insurance is extra, optional protection.

mileage.a: Most of our rentals include mileage suited to your itinerary. Unlimited mileage is available on request, depending on the category and rental length.

deposit.aAmount: For this car, the deposit is {amount} MAD. It is a refundable guarantee and is not included in the rental total.
deposit.a: The deposit is a refundable guarantee and is not included in the rental total. Our team will tell you the amount when confirming.

cancel.a: Yes, under the cancellation terms given when you book.

breakdown.q: What should I do after a breakdown or an accident?
breakdown.a: Contact our assistance team immediately — they are available 24/7.
